en.title: Pay as you go. 15% markup.
en.label: Pricing
en.heading: Pay as you go.
en.description: Services we pay for on your behalf include a 15% markup. Bring your own provider account and pay no platform fee.
en.commitmentDescription: Models are priced at the provider’s published API rate plus 15%. Tools, SMS, calls and remote machines are priced at supplier cost plus 15% when we pay for them on your behalf.

checks.title: Clear price basis
checks.text: Published API prices for models; supplier cost for other services. Each is multiplied by 1.15.

checks.title: Itemised usage
checks.text: See how much you use and what you pay for each service.

checks.title: Bring your own account
checks.text: Pay the provider directly, with no markup or platform fee from us for that service.

exampleRows.label: Model usage at published API rates

en.exampleNote: Illustrative model usage, not a minimum spend or a fixed package. All amounts are in US dollars. Singapore customers pay 9% GST on usage, separately from the 15% markup.

cards.title: Usage plus 15%
cards.text: Use the provider accounts we supply. Your prepaid balance pays for models, tools, SMS, calls and machine time at the rates described above.

cards.title: No platform fee
cards.text: Connect your own model or service account. The provider bills you directly for that service, and we add no markup or platform fee.

cards.title: Top up, then use
cards.text: 1 credit = US$1. Paid usage draws down your balance. No monthly subscription; you pay for what you use.

en.freeNote: Self-hosting the open-source edition is free. Any provider or infrastructure costs you incur remain yours to pay.

faqs.question: Why is there a 15% markup?
faqs.answer: The markup helps cover payment processing, hosting and currency costs when we pay providers on your behalf. We use one percentage across these services so the pricing is straightforward.

faqs.question: How is the markup calculated?
faqs.answer: Multiply the model provider’s published API price, or the supplier cost of tools, SMS, calls and remote machines, by 1.15. Applicable GST is added separately. The example above shows both the price before GST and the Singapore price including GST.

faqs.question: What are credits?
faqs.answer: Credits are your prepaid balance: 1 credit = US$1. Usage and any applicable GST are deducted from that balance.

faqs.question: Can I use my own API keys?
faqs.answer: Yes. Connect your own provider account and pay that provider directly. We charge no markup or platform fee for services billed to your own account.

faqs.question: Is there a subscription?
faqs.answer: No monthly subscription. Pay as you go for the services we pay for on your behalf, or use your own provider accounts.

faqs.question: Can I self-host for free?
faqs.answer: Yes. NyxID is open source under Apache-2.0. You can run it yourself with Docker; your own provider and infrastructure costs still apply.

en.ctaDescription: Use our provider accounts with a clear 15% markup, or connect your own at no platform fee.

zh.pricingHeading: 选择如何向服务商付款

cards.title: 用量加成 15%
cards.text: 使用我们提供的服务商账号。模型、工具、短信、通话和机器用量按上述规则计费，从预付余额中扣除。

cards.title: 不收平台费
cards.text: 接入你自己的模型或服务账号。该项服务由服务商直接向你收费，我们不加价，也不收平台费。

cards.title: 先充值，后使用
cards.text: 1 credit = 1 美元。付费用量从余额中扣除，没有月度订阅费，按实际用量付费。

zh.freeNote: 开源版可免费自托管。你使用的服务商和基础设施费用仍由你承担。

faqs.question: 为什么加成 15%？
faqs.answer: 由我们代付服务商费用时，加成用于分担支付手续费、托管成本和汇率波动。各项代付服务采用同一比例，方便理解和计算。

faqs.question: 加成如何计算？
faqs.answer: 模型按服务商公布的 API 价格，工具、短信、通话和远程机器按供应商成本，统一乘以 1.15。适用的 GST 另计。上方示例同时列出不含 GST 的价格和新加坡含 GST 的价格。

faqs.question: 积分是什么？
faqs.answer: 积分是你的预付余额：1 credit = 1 美元。用量及适用的 GST 从余额中扣除。

faqs.question: 能用我自己的 API 密钥吗？
faqs.answer: 可以。接入自己的服务商账号，直接向服务商付款。由你自己的账号结算的服务，我们不加价，也不收平台费。

faqs.question: 有订阅费吗？
faqs.answer: 没有月度订阅费。由我们代付的服务按用量收费，你也可以使用自己的服务商账号。

faqs.question: 可以免费自托管吗？
faqs.answer: 可以。NyxID 基于 Apache-2.0 开源，可用 Docker 自行部署；你使用的服务商和基础设施费用仍由你承担。

zh.ctaDescription: 使用我们的服务商账号，统一加成 15%；接入自己的账号，不收平台费。
